preconditions.description: The root of the BST must not be None.
The number of nodes in the BST must be between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.expression: all(node.value == original_value + sum_greater_values for node in inorder_traversal(root))
postconditions.description: Each node's value in the modified BST must equal its original value plus the sum of all greater values in the original BST.
The inorder traversal of the modified BST must match the expected output.

invariants.expression: root.left is None or root.left.value < root.value
invariants.description: The left child of any node must have a value less than the node's value.

invariants.expression: root.right is None or root.right.value > root.value
invariants.description: The right child of any node must have a value greater than the node's value.
